text:
Nora (People Ops): Alex P. reported his Feb paystub looks wrong after his mid‑Jan move. It has both NJ nonresident withholding and NY resident withholding plus a commuter (pre-tax transit) deduction that he says he didn't elect. Can payroll + mobility take a look? Pay period 2026-02-01 to 2026-02-28.

Paystub excerpt:
```text
Gross: USD 7,450
Federal: USD 1,120
NY State withholding: USD 420
NJ Nonresident withholding: USD 310
Commuter pre-tax: USD 120
Net: USD 5,480
```
Link: <https://payroll.redwood/secure/stubs/AlexP/2026-02>

Alex P.: Quick context 

 I moved from NYC to Hoboken on 2026-01-18. I filled the state change form and updated home address on 2026-01-19. I didn't enroll in any commuter benefits after the move. I also had a one-time bonus paid in Feb.

Jin (Payroll): Need payrun id + GID to investigate. Did the country/state switch happen before the payroll cutoff? Also check if bonus was tagged as NY-sourced by payroll rules.

Marta (Payroll Ops): Payrun: PR-20260228-88. GID: RWF-8451. System shows employee.state_primary = NJ as of 2026-01-20, but employee.tax_profile had legacy flag `ny_resident_override=true`. Looks like an automatic city/state mapping applied because last known municipal = NYC. Bonus pay element `BONUS_ONEOFF` was processed with source_state=NY by the tax engine. Commuter element `TRANSIT_PRETAX` was present on the run despite no enrollment record.

payroll-bot: Ticket #PAY-13221 created: "Alex P - NY + NJ withholding and stray commuter deduction". Assigned Marta. <https://payroll.redwood/tickets/PAY-13221>

Ivy (Global Mobility): Mobility received Alex's lease and NJ RT card on 2026-01-20. He's a NJ resident for payroll purposes for Feb. No longer NYC resident. I'll add the proof to the ticket.

Tom (Tax): Two things: 1) Bonus sourcing rules commonly tie location on payment date to withholding jurisdiction; if bonus was earned while NY-resident but paid after move, we need to check the payroll policy and state tax nexus rules for supplemental wages. 2) If both NY resident and NJ nonresident withholding occurred, we need to correct one — usually keep resident state's credit and refund the nonresident withholding. W-2 state boxes: we may need to report both states with corrected wages. If corrections happen after W-2 issuance, W-2c will be required.

Alex P.: If they refund the extra withholding, will that be a separate payment or an adjusted net on my next paycheck? Also what about commuter deduction 120? I never enrolled.

Marta (Payroll Ops): Plan: 1) Reverse the erroneous `NY_WITHH` element tied to `BONUS_ONEOFF` and the `NJ_NONRES` if needed depending on correct sourcing; 2) Remove `TRANSIT_PRETAX` and issue reimbursement for the 120 if already taken; 3) Run a net adjustment to correct Feb net or post a separate correction payout in March depending on journal timing. ETA: reversals and reimbursements aim for next payroll (03/15).

Jin (Payroll): Once reversals are posted send the GL journals to payroll-recon so we can close Feb. Note: confirm with benefits vendor whether commuter deduction was pushed from their side (sometimes auto-reattach occurs after location change).

Ivy (Global Mobility): Uploaded lease + move confirmation to PAY-13221. I will also contact our NYC ER rep to verify we should not have a city resident withholding.

Tom (Tax): Regarding W-2 reporting: if both NY and NJ amounts end up on calendar year wages, we'll need to ensure state wages are split correctly on the W-2 in Boxes 15-17. If we reverse before year-end, no W-2c. If after, we'll issue W-2c and notify employee. Also advise Alex to retain his moving docs for state refund claims if the state keeps a nonresident withholding.

Marta (Payroll Ops): Noted. We'll coordinate with tax for proper state wage allocation and with benefits for commuter unwinding. I'll update PAY-13221 as tasks complete.

payroll-bot: PAY-13221 status -> "in progress" (assigned: Marta).

Nora (People Ops): Summary/action owners: Marta 

 reverse wrong state elements + remove commuter + reimbursement; Jin 

 reconcile journals; Ivy 

 add mobility docs + ER contact; Tom 

 monitor W-2/state reporting impact. Alex, we'll DM you with expected timing for the net correction. Thanks all.
